subject: design/feature-draft-local-git
statement: The memory reconciler authorizes a native decision serving a requirement claim that was itself written natively; a claim that mirrors a PRD document row stays covered only by what a design document declares (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design#D-10`). A claim is native when its subject has no PRD ledger, so a document-pipeline feature's addresses can never become native (#DINV-5). Memory's integrity checks stay unchanged for every feature (`prd:feature-draft/NR-4`).
